number.en: Please tell me the number of students in your class.
number.cn: 请告诉我你们班的学生人数。

twenty.en: There are twenty students in our English class today.
twenty.cn: 今天我们英语课有二十个学生。

thirty.en: My dad is thirty years old this year.

fifty.en: Fifty new books arrived at our school library today.
fifty.cn: 今天我们学校图书馆来了五十本新书。

hundred.en: Grandma is almost one hundred years old.

how much.en: How much do these three apples cost in total?
how much.cn: 这三个苹果一共多少钱？

count.en: Can you count from one to one hundred in English?
count.cn: 你能用英语从 1 数到 100 吗？

total.en: Add the prices and tell me the total amount, please.
total.cn: 把价格加起来告诉我总数。
